items.title: Rhizomatics
items.text: Open source software for automating homes and boats, focusing on Home Assistant, MQTT and SignalK.

items.title: Home Automation
items.text:
Open source tools for Home Assistant, MQTT, and self-hosted automation. Everything here is free, source-available on GitHub, and designed to work well with the wider Home Assistant, Python and Docker ecosystems.

  • AutoArm

    Automatically arm Home Assistant alarm panels using calendars, presence, mobile actions, sun state and conditions.

  • Supernotify

    Unified notification for Home Assistant, with chimes, voice announcements, camera snapshots, PTZ camera movements and more.

  • Updates2MQTT

    Use Home Assistant's Updates dialog for self-hosted Docker container updates, with one-click pull and restart.

  • anpr2mqtt

    Integrate ANPR/ALPR cameras via the file system, creating Home Assistant entities for plate reads, with optional UK DVLA lookup.

  • Remote Logger

    OTEL and syslog native remote structured logging for Home Assistant.

  • Awesome MQTT

    A curated list of MQTT brokers, clients, tools and resources.

items.title: Sailing
items.text: Rhizomatics builds open source tools for SignalK, the open marine data standard, intended for low power servers on small boats, alongside a curated directory of boat technology.

items.title: Projects
items.text:
• signalk-cli

    Command line access to SignalK APIs.

  • signalk-datalab-plugin

    Interactive data analysis notebooks for SignalK, running as WebAssembly in the browser.

  • Boat Tech Directory

    A curated list of boat tech: NMEA and Seatalk, marine internet, open source projects, hardware vendors and educational resources.

    Also available as in 'awesome list' format as awesome-boat-tech)
